name: Structured-observation adaptation of Self-Referential Policy Optimization
authorization: User confirmed SRPO after asking to try other RL methods.
initial_checkpoints: All three ppo_history final fits, paired across every arm; no best-seed selection. Historical training costs are shared and retained in original receipts.
grouping: Eight stochastic full trajectories from the same Center game seed, on-policy within each group. Same seed schedule per corresponding fit and arm. No group refill, no homogeneous-group filtering. All-failure or all-success groups yield zero update.
policy: Same 18-dimensional history input and 64x64 SB3 PPO actor initialized from corresponding historical fit. Optimize actor only; inherited critic frozen and verified. Fixed original steering and constraints. Deterministic final evaluation.
encoder: Six observable current features exclude bias, history, horizon, kill/death labels and terminal flags. MLP 6->32 tanh->8 tanh; action-conditioned decoder 9->32 tanh->6 predicts next observation, MSE, Adam .001, 512 batches of 128. Only consecutive nonterminal observations within same historical training episode. One encoder per paired fit; frozen during actor training. Mean and last pre-action latent form 16-dimensional trajectory embedding. No terminal observation is fabricated.
raw_representation: Mean and last of same six pre-action observation features, 12-dimensional. No learned encoder. Different dimension/geometry is a limitation.
reward: Terminal >=10 kills is success=1. Failures use nearest in-group success center Euclidean distance. Standardize success embeddings; DBSCAN eps=.5 min_samples=2; noise excluded, fallback overall success mean. Min-max failure distances; ties map to .5. Reward=.6*sigmoid(10*(.5-normalized_distance)). No successes => all zero. No other task/seed group references, no archive.
paper_code_difference: Pinned official code uses min-max Euclidean distance and .6 maximum failure reward; paper eq5 and appendix describe standardized squared distances and .8. This pilot follows pinned code reward direction/scaling; does not claim exact paper replication.
optimization: Group reward mean and sample standard deviation; same trajectory advantage for its actions. Four full-group Adam updates, clipped importance ratio, exact categorical new||initial KL penalty, entropy bonus, norm clip .5. Equal trajectory weighting, no padded steps. Homogeneous groups skip optimizer entirely. Code/paper aggregation and KL implementation may differ.
budget: 16 groups x 8 completed episodes for each of nine fits: 1152 episodes, at most 207360 transitions. Equal episode and optimizer-opportunity budgets, not equal transitions/updates/wall time. Report actual counts, homogeneous groups and encoder costs. Frozen PPO reference receives no additional training and is not a matched-compute comparator.
continuation: Latent variant must exceed each of binary, raw, frozen PPO and always-fire by >=.5 mean Center kills; Line kill and both duration differences must be >=-.5; each latent episode p95 decision time <1ms. These are descriptive development thresholds. Report crossed paired 95% bootstrap intervals with only three model seeds, no multiplicity correction. Never treat pilot as confirmation. No fallback or tuning if gate fails; a positive pilot only motivates a separately frozen fresh confirmation.
claim_boundary: Doom adaptation using privileged structured observations, pretrained PPO policy and small locally learned one-step dynamics representation, not SRPO V-JEPA/OpenVLA/LIBERO replication. Sparse >=10-kill goal differs from earlier dense PPO objective. Both scenarios previously seen; not unseen-task generalization. No new RL algorithm, Bayesian inference or conference novelty claim.
